[0:13:59](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=3Nnh6jiGUIs&t=839s) Process for me has Always been year -round and I say that as being year -round even though you start and go from July 1 to June 30 in the month of July there are already ideas Coming on board for things that I think that should be instituted for the Following year whether they can be done in the next budget year or the following Year the capital improvement plan that you would have for community would Would outline expenditures for road improvements, Parks, buildings, facilities, And if you have the proper plan in place along with what I consider to be a five -year budget, and what I mean by that is Not only having a current year budget, Having last year's budget information, And also projections for the next three years, Everybody fully understands What are gonna be some of your expenditures That are going to be coming up so there's no surprises that you're going to need to do some improvements within DPW or do some improvements within the Lift stations or maybe the fire truck of $700 ,000 that you're going to have to be Purchased is coming down the line so you're aware that that's going to be Coming up so when you start to have budget meetings earlier in the year and I speak of early in January where you start to set some of your goals or Or objectives in written form by the council, You're already aware of some of the things That are about to take place. Now I think it's important for each department To be able to meet with their department employees And start to talk about some of the things that are needed At particular areas and their expertise. Those particular meetings start to happen Before the end of the year. I think it's important also before the end of the year, and I'm speaking of a calendar year when I say this, that City Council would meet and set a goals and objectives meeting that they can use to project some of those potential ideas, the policy, the things that they want to institute for the upcoming year to ensure that the department heads know within each department what are some of the priorities for the upcoming year that they need to think about this within their thought process When they are starting to establish some of the things that they need for the upcoming year. I think it's important when you have this capital improvement plan and purchase this plan, And as I say, it's a five -year budget, the public knows exactly where you are. You put these things online. They know when some of the streets are going to be done. They know that their street is going to be overlaid. The one to block down is going to be reconstructed. They know they're going to be doing crack sealing on another block. you know you can be roofing one of the DPW buildings everybody knows some Things that are about to happen I realize as not only just a strategic Plan but a budget plan does potentially change based upon some expenditures that May unfortunately come up or the ability to raise certain funds through grants That may be able to allow you to move up some expenditures within within the Upcoming year so starting the process for myself starts early early in the year I start to write down things that I they're going to be coming up for next Year you start to talk with the department heads about some things that They're going to be needing you have the goal -setting meeting before the end of The calendar year with council so you get those particular things in place you Start to assemble numbers based upon prior years budget so department heads Would meet with the individual who is keeping track of the expenditures for The year so they know exactly where they are in relationship to the upcoming year With a budget okay we spent 78 % of this budget but we still need to make this Purchase or we're already over in this particular department are you going to Be able to cut back in some of the areas so you're not over budget and then you Start to have your budget meetings with counsel you may get department heads That are together you start to talk about those priorities you have your Your budget work sessions with council whether you have public that's involved In some of those discussions as well they start to institute and start to Provide information and then through the Charter you adopt it in accordance with with whatever the dates and meetings are set Thank You councilman rapprochement
